title: Zaporizhzhia: Evacuation ordered
description: In the morning in Kyiv, a Russian drone hit a residential high-rise building. Four people were injured. As usual, our rescuers worked quickly: the fire has now been extinguished. At night in Odesa there was a hit at the international checkpoint "Starokazache" on the border with Moldova. His work is suspended. Unfortunately, two people died, three more were injured, sixteen were evacuated by rescuers...
